stories.title: Central Vietnam floods worsen as troops prepare rescue operations
stories.summary: Heavy rain continued across central Vietnam on Friday, flooding parts of Hue after inundating Da Nang. Hue recorded more than 800 mm of rain over three days, and authorities warned that further rain could trigger flash floods and landslides through Sunday.
stories.why: This is an immediate safety and infrastructure issue for central Vietnam, with risks to residents, transport and local businesses. Follow local evacuation and weather warnings as conditions evolve.

stories.title: China tightens oversight of AI while warning against tech investment bubbles
stories.summary: New Chinese policy guidelines call for breakthroughs in core AI technology and more computing capacity, while directing officials to curb blind investment, manage AI risks and keep systems safe, reliable and controllable.
stories.why: The policy shows Beijing trying to accelerate domestic AI capability while limiting speculative investment and strengthening state oversight. It may shape where Chinese AI infrastructure and industrial applications receive support.

stories.title: UK regulator secures data-protection commitments from ten major AI developers
stories.summary: The UK's Information Commissioner's Office said ten leading AI developers, including OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and DeepSeek, have made or committed to make changes such as clearer data-use disclosures, stronger ways for people to exercise data rights and improved safeguards. The regulator is also seeking evidence on risks from AI agents.
stories.why: This could lead to clearer privacy controls and data-handling explanations for people using AI services in the UK. The commitments are not all completed changes, and the regulator says it will monitor follow-through.

stories.title: NASA opens nearly 800 GB of Artemis II lunar science data to the public
stories.summary: NASA released an Artemis II archive containing more than 11,000 full-resolution images and videos, 8.5 hours of spoken observations, transcripts and astronaut annotations. Early analysis includes five observed lunar impact flashes and detailed records of lunar color, terrain and lighting.
stories.why: The archive gives researchers new human-observed lunar data to study impact rates, geology and surface conditions. Findings can inform hazard planning for future crewed lunar missions.

stories.title: Proton 11.0-2e fixes EA App launcher issues under Steam Play
stories.summary: Valve and CodeWeavers released Proton 11.0-2e, a compatibility update for running Windows games on Linux. It fixes the EA App login window failing to receive focus properly under Gamescope and incorrect splash images for EA App titles.
stories.why: For Steam Deck and Linux desktop players, launcher problems can prevent games from starting even when the game itself is compatible. This is a targeted fix rather than a major performance overhaul.
